case_title.quote: MAIN PAL v. STATE OF HARYANA

number_of_accused.quote: the appellant jumped over the front wall of her house
number_of_accused.reason: A single accused, the appellant, is tried.

accused_gender.reason: The accused is referred to as male.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the house of the accused was at a distance of 15-16 houses from the house of Prakashi Devi
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Same village, not on visiting terms; DW-1 alleged a water-course quarrel with the complainant's son.

offence_category.quote: with intent to outrage her modesty
offence_category.reason: A s.354 modesty offence plus trespass; Sexual assault is a reasonable category.

statutory_provisions.quote: offence punishable under section 452 IPC ... under section 354 IPC

evidence_type.quote: The investigating officer was examined as PW-3.
evidence_type.reason: PW-1, PW-2, the FIR and the investigating officer are the evidence noted.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced him for rigorous imprisonment for six months and a fine of Rs.1,000/- in default thereof simple imprisonment for one month

high_court_outcome.quote: upholding the conviction but reducing the sentence from six to four months rigorous imprisonment
high_court_outcome.reason: Conviction was upheld and sentence reduced; calling it dismissed is a minor wording difference.

final_outcome.quote: remitted to the trial court with a direction for a new trial

offence_finally_established.quote: the conviction of the accused is set aside

imprisonment_type.quote: the conviction of the accused is set aside

neutral_facts.reason: Accurate to the evidence, anonymised, and does not disclose the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment.

attempt_completion.reason: The case concerns an attempt to outrage modesty.

number_of_offences.quote: offence punishable under section 452 IPC ... section 354 IPC

financial_property_loss.reason: Only broken bulbs, with no value stated.

premeditation_planning.quote: after having made preparation for causing hurt or assault
premeditation_planning.reason: The charge alleges preparation; the court made no finding.

motive.quote: quarrel between the accused and complainant's son Surinder about a water course
motive.reason: Alleged by DW-1 and marked as alleged.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: he touched/caught the hand of Sheela Devi and when she raised an alarm he ran away
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The court noted this evidence but did not decide guilt.

witness_credibility.quote: She also admitted that the appellant did not touch her nor teased her nor abused her.

legal_representation.quote: Vikas Sharma, K.M. Gupta, Praveen Swarup for the Appellant.

procedural_irregularity.quote: There was a material error in the charge

appeal_history.quote: The appeal filed by the accused was dismissed by the Addl. Sessions Judge on 20.2.2002

prosecution_argument.correct_value: The State (respondent) relied on State of Himachal Pradesh v. Geeta Ram; the lower courts held the accused cannot take advantage of a technical defect in the charge.
prosecution_argument.quote: The respondent relied upon the decision of this court in State of Himachal Pradesh v. Geeta Ram
prosecution_argument.reason: The judgment does record the State's reliance on Geeta Ram, so 'Not stated' is incomplete.

defence_argument.quote: as he was not required to defend himself against a charge that he assaulted and outraged the modesty of Sheela Devi, he ought to have been acquitted

legal_principle_applied.quote: The accused is entitled to know with certainty and accuracy, the exact nature of the charge against him

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Willie (William) Slaney vs. State of Madhya Pradesh [AIR 1956 SC 116]
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Cases and citations match; Geeta Ram was distinguished.

other_sentence_order.quote: substituting the words "her daughter-in-law Sheela Devi" for the words "abovenamed Prakashi Devi"
